client_profile:
TechNova Payments and TechNova Credit process personal data across the digital payments and consumer lending value chain, including customer identity and contact details, KYC documents, transaction and device logs, credit repayment behaviour, and partner- and merchant-sourced records shared through aggregator and bureau ecosystems. This data supports beneficiary onboarding, disbursal, fraud monitoring, and customer servicing.

The DPDP Act, 2023 would assess this data through purpose limitation, consent notices in clear languages, data minimisation, security safeguards, and grievance redressal, while obligations of Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors govern cross-entity sharing, retention limits, and breach notification for both entities.

categories.title: Identity & KYC Data
categories.summary: Collected during onboarding under RBI KYC norms to verify customer identity for payments and lending accounts.
bullets: Full name, date of birth, gender, photograph and signature
PAN, Aadhaar number and e-KYC authentication records
Passport, driving licence or voter ID used for KYC
Video-KYC recordings and liveness checks (TechNova Credit onboarding)
Mother's name, marital status and nominee details

categories.title: Contact & Demographic Data
categories.summary: Basic contact details used for account management, OTP delivery, statements and service communications across both subsidiaries.
bullets: Mobile number, email address, postal and current residence address
Occupation, employer, income bracket and education (lending applications)
Preferred language and communication channel
Emergency or reference contacts supplied by the customer

categories.title: Financial & Transaction Data
categories.summary: Core payment and account data processed by TechNova Payments to operate wallets, UPI handles and merchant settlements.
bullets: Bank account numbers, IFSC, card PAN, expiry and CVV tokens
UPI VPA handles, wallet balances and instrument tokens
Transaction logs: amount, timestamp, counterparty, channel, status
Merchant settlement, refund and chargeback records
Bank statements and income evidence submitted for loan eligibility

categories.title: Credit & Loan Data
categories.summary: Data processed by TechNova Credit for underwriting, disbursal, repayment tracking and collections under RBI digital-lending guidelines.
bullets: Loan applications, sanction letters, KFS and agreement records
Credit bureau scores and reports (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF)
Repayment schedules, EMI mandates, delinquency and write-off status
Account-Consent-Framework (account aggregator) data shared with consent
Collection call logs and settlement negotiations

categories.title: Device & Digital Behavioural Data
categories.summary: App and web telemetry collected for security, fraud prevention and UX analytics, raising DPDP purpose-limitation considerations.
bullets: Device identifiers, OS, app version and requested app permissions
IP address, coarse geolocation and session logs
Cookies, device fingerprints and in-app clickstream
Crash logs and performance telemetry
RBI digital-lending rules restrict unnecessary contact/SMS access

categories.title: Fraud, AML & Compliance Data
categories.summary: Data retained to meet PMLA, RBI and tax obligations, including screening, audit trails and fraud-investigation records.
bullets: AML/CFT screening results against sanctions and PEP lists
Suspicious-transaction monitoring flags and STR/CTR filings
Fraud investigation case files and device-blacklist records
Audit logs and evidence retained for statutory inspection
TDS/GST-linked identity records for reporting

categories.title: Consent, Grievance & Support Records
categories.summary: Records evidencing DPDP consent artefacts and customer-service interactions handled by the group grievance officer.
bullets: Consent notices, artefacts, timestamps and withdrawal records
Grievance tickets, complaint correspondence and resolution timelines
Call-centre recordings, chat transcripts and email threads
Escalations to DPDPB or sectoral ombudsman, if filed

categories.title: Marketing & Preference Data
categories.summary: Contact lists, campaign responses and preference flags used for cross-selling loans and payment offers.
bullets: Campaign response history across SMS, push, email and WhatsApp
Product-interest and eligibility segments
Do-not-call, opt-out and consent-withdrawal flags (TRAI and DPDP)
Referral and loyalty programme participation data
Children's data barred from tracking-based targeted ads absent parental consent

categories.title: Merchant & Partner Data
categories.summary: Individual-level data of merchants, agents, vendors and employees processed for onboarding, payments and compliance across the group.
bullets: Proprietor/director KYC for merchant onboarding and UPI/PSP tie-ups
Settlement bank details and merchant transaction history
Field-agent location tracking and performance records
Employee HR, payroll and background-verification records
